name: REST GET
description: Fetch data: request params built from a JSON Schema; 4xx -> BPMN error HTTP_<status>.

properties.label: URL
properties.description: Request URL. Supports ${expressions} and {placeholders} that are filled from params with "x-in": "path". Example: ${apiBaseUrl}/users/{userId}

properties.label: Sources
properties.description: Comma separated process variable names (or a JSON literal) deep-merged in order - later wins. Example: currentUser, userChanges

properties.label: Params schema
properties.description: JSON Schema for path / query / header params. Each top-level property is one param: "x-in": path | query | header (default query); arrays repeat, objects flatten to name.child. Paste the JSON Schema itself (inline JSON object), not a file path. Use "x-expression": "varName" (no dollar-brace wrapper) for expressions - the engine evaluates any dollar-brace text in this field before the connector runs. Keep it under ~4000 characters (engine string-variable limit).

pattern.message: Must be an inline JSON object { ... }

properties.label: Static headers
properties.description: JSON object, values may use ${expressions}. Example: {"X-Correlation-Id": "${execution.processInstanceId}"}

properties.label: JWT (bearer token)
properties.description: Optional. Sends Authorization: Bearer <token>. Give the NAME of the process variable that holds the token (e.g. accessToken) - preferred, the token is read at runtime and no copy is stored in history. A token literal or the result of an expression also works. Overrides an Authorization header from Static headers / params. HTTP 401/403 -> BPMN error HTTP_401 / HTTP_403.

properties.label: Response schema
properties.description: Optional JSON Schema: shapes the response (drops unknown fields) and validates it. Violation -> BPMN error RESPONSE_INVALID. Paste the JSON Schema itself (inline JSON object), not a file path. Use "x-expression": "varName" (no dollar-brace wrapper) for expressions - the engine evaluates any dollar-brace text in this field before the connector runs. Keep it under ~4000 characters (engine string-variable limit).

pattern.message: Must be an inline JSON object { ... }

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Process variable receiving the response body (stored as JSON).

pattern.message: Must be a valid variable name

properties.label: Status variable
properties.description: Process variable receiving the HTTP status code.

pattern.message: Must be a valid variable name

properties.label: Async before (enables job retries on 5xx / timeouts)
